text:
Maria: heads-up — multiple Dedicated customers reporting a sudden throughput drop on r-gpu-pool-12, getting intermittent 429s and long tail latency. started ~09:10 UTC. raising here for triage
Anya: thanks — can you paste the failing request sample + response? any recent deploys? @OncallBot was there an autoscale event? :eyes:
Maria: curl sample: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate` response: `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded", "message":"throttled by tenant fair-queue"}` logs: `queue_depth=120 -> active_workers=8 -> avg_batch_size=2.1`
OncallBot: autoscale: scale-up triggered at 09:05 UTC from 10->14 nodes, scale-down inhibited due to ongoing tenant loads.
Sam: avg_batch_size=2.1 is killer for throughput. looks like continuous-batcher is flushing too aggressively. could be idle_flush_ms too low or max_batch_tokens set tiny for this model. any config drift after deploy?
Maria: no config deploys from our side. infra shows a recent runtime restart on those hosts at 08:58 UTC (kube rolling), maybe new default params loaded.
Kai: what are model + runtime params? send `rbxctl get runtime-config --pool r-gpu-pool-12`
Maria: pasted output snippet: `model: xlarge-8b, max_batch_tokens: 2048, continuous_batcher_idle_flush_ms: 2, max_concurrent_requests_per_worker: 6, scheduler_fair_weights: {tenant:1, shared:1}` — idle_flush=2ms looks suspiciously low (should be 15-50ms).
Anya: that explains tiny batches. continuous-batcher was optimized in canary to reduce latency but this pool seems to have the aggressive change. We should bump idle_flush to 25ms and increase max_batch_tokens to 4096 for this model. Quick mitigation: increase worker concurrency limit and route noisy tenant to their reserved pool.
Sam: immediate mitigation steps I can run: 1) patch pool config to idle_flush_ms=25 2) bump max_batch_tokens=4096 3) enable soft-isolation for top noisy tenant id: t-corp-42. anyone object?
Kai: +1. Also add a short-term scheduler change: raise tenant fair weight to 2 so large tenant gets proportionate batching vs many small ones. That'll reduce starvation.
Maria: doing the patch now for idle_flush + max_batch_tokens, rolling config to nodes in pool. will post results in 2-3 mins.
AutoDeployBot: applied config update to r-gpu-pool-12: continuous_batcher_idle_flush_ms=25, max_batch_tokens=4096 (job id: deploy-1864001234-config).
Maria: after rollback: avg_batch_size climbed to 8.6, queue_depth fell to ~30, 429s dropped, p95 latency improved from 480ms -> 210ms. Customer reported fewer errors.
Anya: great. we should audit other pools for accidental aggressive idle_flush values. @Sam can you add a config-guard in platform that warns if idle_flush_ms < 10ms for production pools?
Sam: yep will add a lint + CI check. also scheduling note: long-term we should have autoscaler aware of effective throughput (tokens/sec) not just nodes. filing follow-up ticket.
Kai: add regression test to eval harness that measures avg_batch_size under synthetic mixed-tenant load so we catch configs that force micro-batches.
Maria: filed incident (INC-18640) and notified customer. closing here once Sam's guard lands. thx all :pray:
